newsitem.title: USA: Durco, BW/IP to merge in stock swap.
newsitem.headline: Durco, BW/IP to merge in stock swap.

text.p: Durco International Inc and BW/IP Inc said they have agreed to a stock swap that creates an industrial manufacturing company with a market capitalization of about $1.2 billion.
Both companies make and distribute pumps, seals and valves, as well as fluid handling and control equipment.

Under terms of the agreement, Durco will pay each BW/IP shareholder 0.6968 Durco shares for each of their BW/IP shares, the companies said. Durco holders will retain their present shares, which closed Monday at 26-5/8.
